data.summary_en: TeleTune learns a textual skill library from goal-free, non-replayable, task-interleaved offline logs, proposes edits by action-prediction error, keeps only edits improving held-out action-prediction accuracy, and reaches 77.1% and 80.6% average success rates on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web, up 6.7% and 7.7% over each benchmark's strongest baseline.
